Data & methodology

Estimates come from Pitt’s University Center for Social and Urban Research. The two periods each pool five years of ACS responses. Some profiles cover multiple neighborhoods because census and city boundaries differ. The map uses city boundaries and highlights every neighborhood represented by a selected profile.

Chateau and South Shore lack published profiles. The map shows estimates and simple percentage-point differences. Small differences may reflect sampling error. Commuting by transit measures use among workers age 16 and older, and renter share measures tenure among occupied housing units.
